decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 02 march 2007, the erection of a single storey rear infill extension measuring 1.80m width x 3.65m depth x 2.80m to 3.55m height and a rear dormer measuring 4.55m width x 3.45m depth x 2.15m height, not exceeding the original roofline of the house, with three velux windows to the front roof-slope was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the proposed extension to the loft was less than 40m3 and when combined, the total extension do not exceed 50m3.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a rear roof extension and part single storey side/rear infill extension to replace existing conservatory to original house
